answer_1.quote: We assess the model's performance by evaluating its final prediction using the Exact Match (EM) criteria ... This evaluation considers four key metrics: #Turns, Success rate, #Yes, Score.
answer_1.outputs: Generated series of yes/no/maybe questions and final entity guesses

answer_2.quote: We assess the model's performance by evaluating its final prediction using the Exact Match (EM) criteria ... The mean and standard deviation were calculated using ... metrics #Turns, Success, #Yes, Score.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-3.5-turbo as the judge. The judge takes the entity, questions from the guesser and the following prompt to generate a response of "Yes," "No," or "Maybe".

answer_4.quote: We recruited 108 non-paid internal volunteers to interact with the J, and collected a total of 145 and 71 human game play sessions for Things-30 and Celebrities-30 ... We used the same instructions as the LLM guessers and provided a tutorial.
answer_4.guideline: Human participants were given the same instruction prompt as the LLM guesser and a tutorial; games were recorded and evaluated on success, number of turns, and number of Yes responses.
